gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds, p8 (Electric Fund, Sewer Fund) and p9 (Natural Gas Fund, Water Fund, Allocated Administration, Total); printed p21 across two pages. No enterprise schedule exists and detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts (Total column) = Residential 1,820,980 + Commercial 1,096,726 + Municipal 54,765 + Industrial 768,709 + Sewer use fees 515,205 + Customer charges 1,000,151 + Other revenue 179,098 + Interest income 5,862 + Grant revenue 176,361 + Gain on sale of capital assets 3,100 + Miscellaneous income 4,711 = 5,625,668. Per column: Electric 1,085,390 + 587,063 + 30,799 + 654,682 + 379,425 + 103,463 = 2,840,822; Sewer 515,205 + 1,800 + 175,461 + 3,100 = 695,566; Natural Gas 600,735 + 413,198 + 9,862 + 114,027 + 435,806 + 40,762 + 36 = 1,614,426; Water 134,855 + 96,465 + 14,104 + 184,920 + 6,377 = 436,721; Allocated Administration 26,696 + 5,862 + 900 + 4,675 = 38,133. Sum 5,625,668. After fix: 0 + 5,625,668 = 5,625,668. The 'Allocated Administration' column is printed under the Enterprise Funds heading and carries part of every total, so it is added under its printed heading. The governmental statement p5 prints only Transfers in / Transfers out under other financing (no other rows).

gaps.explanation: Same statement pp8-9. JSON disbursements = Total column operating expenses 4,584,335 + Interest expense 8,021 + Loan administration fees 3,107 = 4,595,463 (the Total column prints '-' for 'Allocated administrative expenses', so it has no statement line). Per column total operating expenses as printed: Electric 2,295,247 (incl. Professional fees (3,172) kept negative and Allocated administrative expenses 264,941); Sewer 510,050 (incl. allocated 49,870); Natural Gas 1,339,672 (incl. allocated 151,692); Water 412,361 (incl. allocated 41,339); Allocated Administration 27,005 (incl. Allocated administrative expenses (507,842)) plus Interest expense 8,021 and Loan administration fees 3,107. The allocation cells net to zero: 264,941 + 49,870 + 151,692 + 41,339 - 507,842 = 0, matching the Total '-'; they are printed amounts and are kept (as printed, never removed). Sum 2,295,247 + 510,050 + 1,339,672 + 412,361 + 27,005 + 8,021 + 3,107 = 4,595,463. After fix: 0 + 4,595,463 = 4,595,463.
